description: (d) Mentions sensitive topics (health, religion, politics, finances) that must NOT appear in the profile

answers.transcript: So Saturday mornings I usually go to church with my family, then honestly I need a lot of downtime because of my anxiety, my therapist says I should rest more. Afternoon I'd go on a long bike ride along the river and then do some watercolor painting on the porch. Evening maybe a small dinner with one close friend.

A lot of political stuff honestly, I'm pretty progressive so it's a lot of election coverage. Otherwise cycling route videos and watercolor tutorials, like loose floral stuff. And budgeting TikToks because I'm kind of broke right now with my student loans.
A multi-day bike touring trip, like camping along the way, but I don't know anyone who'd do it with me.
